crossRefs.note: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God…
His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
You mountains, that you skipped like rams; you little hills, like lambs?
For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up; and it…
I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.
The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.
Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

The mountains quaked Yahweh’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.

translations.web: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.
translations.bsb: The mountains quake before Him, and the hills melt away; the earth trembles at His presence— the world and all its dwellers.
translations.kjv: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell
translations.asv: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt; and the earth is upheaved at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
